ruff reports no issues on either modified file.

summary: WP-005 code review PASS. pm.py correctly uses preamble (plan file reference) and extra (plan document content) per VARIABLES.md. synthesis.py correctly omits wp_id — the project-scoped design intent is explicitly documented in the function docstring. Defensive OSError handling in pm.py is the right approach. Both modules are clean, minimal, and consistent with the WP-004 pattern established across the other 6 stage modules. No blocking issues.

comments.note: pm.py's OSError fallback (`[Could not read plan file at {plan_path}: {exc}]`) is a good defensive pattern — it prevents an unhandled exception from crashing the orchestrator stage and produces a recoverable sentinel value the PM agent can interpret. No change needed.

synthesis.py docstring on _build_synthesis_prompt() correctly calls out the intentional absence of current_wp_id — this is exactly the right place to document a non-obvious design decision. Good practice.
No architectural observations — pm.py and synthesis.py are clean, minimal, and correctly implement the template-based pattern. Both are consistent with the WP-004 modules.
